rationale: No record change is submitted this cycle. I attempted to revise the snapshot-trigger Fact (1f6e894a67e24249ab6b8dbbcd9e76e3-knowledge-0) so its consequence sentence no longer implies a per-interval recurrence and no longer relies on the stored-snapshot count, which source reading of the in-memory and file-backed snapshot stores showed cannot track snapshot attempts. Validation rejected the correction twice because a knowledge update may not carry a revision field and because the affected-use reference must be revision-qualified in a form this batch did not satisfy; rather than submit an inaccurate or non-conforming revision I am leaving the Fact text untouched and recording the correction here. The defect account and its interpretation are unaffected: the spurious verdict is established by its own witness and the recorded consequence already states the withdrawal of the per-interval wording and the unusable proxy.
